content: I’ve really been struggling with this feeling (is it a feeling? A sensation? A vibe?)… For those of us playing with AI all the time, we’re developing an overly sensitive OMG-THAT’S-AI alarm. It’s like once you see it, you cannot unsee it. You see AI-like patterns. Then you think you’re crazy. But are you? OMG, WHAT IS REALITY?! 🙃
